result: Fixed the open redirect in `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts` by adding a `sanitizeRedirect` helper that only accepts a value beginning with a single `/` not followed by another `/` or a `\`, rejecting absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs (`//evil.example`), and backslash variants (`/\evil.example`) — anything rejected falls back to the existing default of `/dashboard`. The `store` action now runs the `redirect` value (from the validated body or query string) through this sanitizer before passing it to `this.redirect(...)`, while sign-in/credential handling is untouched. I added `tests/LoginController.test.ts` covering: redirecting to a valid same-app path, the default fallback with no redirect, rejection of absolute-URL/protocol-relative/backslash redirect values, and that a wrong password still fails with a 422 and no session. `bun test` (8/8) and `bun run typecheck` both pass.
